title: Teaching of Christ
definition: The teaching of Christ is His authoritative instruction concerning God, the kingdom, repentance, faith, obedience, discipleship, judgment, and eternal life.
summary: Jesus teaches with divine authority and calls people to hear and obey.
christFocus: Christ is the Teacher whose words reveal truth and lead to life.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Jesus taught with authority unlike the scribes. His teaching reveals the Father, exposes the heart, announces the kingdom, explains righteousness, warns of judgment, and calls sinners to faith and repentance.

His teaching is not optional inspiration. It is the word of the Lord to be heard, trusted, and obeyed.

The risen Christ commands His disciples to teach others to observe all He commanded.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often admire Jesus' sayings while ignoring His authority. The teaching of Christ matters because His words are truth and life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not merely quote Jesus when convenient. Build your life on His words, obey what He commands, and teach others faithfully.
